metadata.evidence_policy: Ingestion and bounded consistency are not execution or task completion.

execution_policy.development_inputs: Current repository source at the baseline commit. No new SDK pins, screenshots, or private case data.
execution_policy.implementation_provider_scope: Authorized Grok 4.7 development implementation via llm_router. Offline tests do not disable that provider process. Development permission is not consent to case-data egress.
execution_policy.native_task_source_profile: explicit legacy-markdown projection of the Native FormalWorkPlan
execution_policy.parallelism: Tasks with satisfied dependencies and disjoint targets may run together, up to four lanes. CIMP-MOD-01 and CIMP-MOD-02 start together. Package interfaces CIMP-MOD-04 through CIMP-MOD-11 run together after the schema task. Package documentation runs with the boundary tasks once their own interface exists.
execution_policy.product_inference: This plan does not change case inference, consent, or legal conclusions.
execution_policy.protected_state: Completed intake, mediator-grounding, GUI collaboration, and GUI UX campaigns, both retained quarantines, submodule pins, and unrelated campaign processes stay untouched.
execution_policy.qualification_scope: One focused new test module per task. Do not run the full historical suite inside the 900-second task budget.
required_evidence: A focused pytest module with positive and negative cases and zero skips
Version strings and owner paths that match the current tree
No behavior change outside a declared shim whose signatures already match
execution_policy.stop_semantics: A divergent duplicate implementation is recorded as divergent. It is not silently merged and it is not marked complete by a caller flag.
execution_policy.upstream_checkout_policy: Use the pinned external/ipfs_accelerate_py, external/ipfs_datasets_py, and external/ipfs_kit_py checkouts. Do not float pins, recursively initialize submodules, or clone CommonCrawl.
